autopilot_principle: Brenden supplies goals and exceptions. The GatorBait controller owns scope, policy, state, writes, verification and learning. Deterministic checks run first; models and specialist workflows return bounded evidence or drafts to the controller. Routine approved work may proceed inside these boundaries, while approval_required conditions escalate to Brenden.
